_note: Frank's approach lines: the gate display shows no bar or ratio, so these four one-shot messages are how the player hears the Series A door getting closer. Each speaks at most once per run (latch.one_shot is spent at admission, so an MRR dip and re-cross never brings it back) and carries no number. The step comes from phase.series_a_approach, which counts PhaseGateSystem.APPROACH_PCTS marks cleared against the gate's own finance.mrr leaf; the bar is never in this file. This one: the door itself. It reads the RATCHET, exactly like funding.gate_series_a, so a dip below the bar after the latch does not silence it. funding.gate_series_a carries a history leaf on this card (days_since >= 1): Frank says the door is open first, and the decision comes on a later day, never the same one. It is deliberately NOT pulled from the queue when a shutter starts (PhaseGateSystem.on_shutter_started): a removal writes no history row, and the Series A card would then wait on it forever.
speaker: char_mentor_frank
